# Mateusz Salamon

> Angular frontend developer and AI consultant based in Poland. Builds user interfaces for the financial sector and delivers faster with AI-assisted development (Claude Code, MCP, agentic workflows). Open to B2B contracts, remote with EU, UK and US-East overlap.

## Profile
- Stack: Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, RxJS, NgRx, NGXS, HTML5, SCSS, Jasmine, Git/GitHub, REST APIs, .NET
- AI: Claude Code, Github Copilot, Codex, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Skills, agentic workflows, AI-assisted unit and E2E testing
- Domains: cloud-based asset management platform used by banks; portfolio monitoring app for a German bank; dealer–bank financial document exchange
- Certifications: Google UX Design, Microsoft Azure
- Languages: Polish (native), English
- Contact: contact@salamonsoftware.com
